pixeltaku.reason: Public page labels NoAI; permission for intended VLA use unresolved. Anonymous metadata request reports mayDownloadThisModel=false. No downloaded geometry or render; not an accepted asset.
pixeltaku.geometry_note: Author says buttons attached to main body mesh. This is NOT a rejection reason: disconnected islands can be separated and connected surfaces can be cut/reconstructed after inspecting the actual file. No topology inspection has occurred.

lucasmunillaclavero.user_hardware: User reports Splatoon 3 edition, same mesh as ordinary Switch Pro with different shell textures. This identifies requested geometry family; it is not verification of this downloaded mesh.
